lead_raw_text:
The structure of K2Zr2N2 (KZN) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with six atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies N-centered octahedra with four K and two Zr neighbors, while K centers have nine geometric neighbors (four N, two K, three Zr) and Zr centers have eight N neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all six sites, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between N octahedra and corner-sharing between K 9-vertex polyhedra.
